title: Gibson Phosphor Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings, Medium Gauge

long_description.body:
Developed under the direction of Gibson’s Master Luthiers, Gibson Phosphor Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings give your guitar a warm response across all frequencies. Compared to 80/20 bronze strings, phosphor bronze provides a more balanced overall tone, so you can expect clarity in the upper registers without sacrificing your guitar’s natural low and midrange character. They excel in solo performance and singer-songwriter accompaniment, and any setting where expressive dynamics are essential.



The hex-shaped, tinned steel core provides strength and volume, while the phosphor bronze wrap ensures balanced, full tones
Uncoated for authentic acoustic feel and sound
Developed and tested by Gibson Master Luthiers for all Gibson acoustic guitars
Made in the USA
Ultra-Light Gauge: .011, .015, .022w, .032, .042, .052
Light Gauge: .012, .016, .024w, .032, .042, .053
Medium Gauge: .013, .017, .026w, .035, .045, .056
